}}'''Mairin Gome''' is the owner and manager of a touring circus similar to the rival show owned by [[Valan Luca]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Mairin Gome|MG}}

==Activities==
When Luca led his [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|traveling show]] to [[Samara]], he was annoyed that Mairin Gome had arrived before him.{{ref/book|5|36}} Her circus included two women who performed on a hanging rope.{{ref/book|5|38}}  At one point the line to enter Mairin's show was almost as long as Luca's.{{ref||MG}}
